name: @airprompter/zapier
description: AirPrompter Agents for Zapier: each Zap step serves one approved, signed prompt slot (A/B and dial-up decided in AirPrompter), reports usage and quality, and keeps serving from a signed copy stored on the Zapier side while AirPrompter is unreachable.

scripts.validate: npm run build && npx --yes --package zapier-platform-cli@19.3.0 zapier-platform validate
